## Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you would like to see added.

## Motivation / Use Case

Why is this feature needed? What problem does it solve? How would it improve the project?

Describe your proposed implementation approach or any ideas you have.

## Alternatives Considered

Are there any alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered?

## Additional Context

Any other context, mockups, or references that would help explain the feature request.
